import pytest
from pathlib import Path


def log_line(level: str, message: str) -> None:
    """Print ``[level] message`` to standard output.

    Console output only. This function must not open, create,
    or write to any file.
    """
    print(f"[{level}] {message}")


def test_log_line_formats_level_and_message(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "started")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] started\n"


def test_log_line_prints_one_line_per_call(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    log_line("WARN", "disk low")
    log_line("ERROR", "crashed")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[WARN] disk low\n[ERROR] crashed\n"


def test_log_line_writes_no_files(
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    log_line("DEBUG", "no files please")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[DEBUG] no files please\n"
    assert list(tmp_path.iterdir()) == []
